message.content:
The analysis shows that the raw difference in conversion rates (email minus paid_search) is 0.0785, but this is confounded by differences in customer_segment, customer_age, and status. The stratum-level differences vary widely — some are negative, some positive — and the weighted average difference (adjusted for confounding) is **-0.1404**, indicating that after adjustment, paid_search actually outperforms email.

This reversal shows that the crude difference is misleading due to confounding. The correct estimate of the causal effect is the adjusted difference.

I will now submit the answer with the adjusted effect, properly documented.
